note: Declarative post-phase state updates for the MDP-7 orchestrator pipeline. Read by orchestrator.agent.md (and the sub-agent finishing a stage) after a stage completes, to know which artifacts must be updated before handing off. This is NOT a Claude Code PostToolUse hook (unlike .claude/hooks/log-artifact-change.sh) — there is no native tool-level event for an orchestrator 'phase'; the orchestrator consults it as a checklist. See .claude/hooks/README.md.

update.action: regenerate the baseline snapshot from docs/requirements.md if it changed materially
add the unresolved item to section 6, Open Questions
clear the resolved item from 'Open Design Questions' for the task's area
set the task's status to its next state (e.g. ready -> in_review)
record the actual pass/fail/skip result per Test Coverage Checklist case touched by this task
record the failing case(s) and reason
append an Approved review round entry
append a Changes Requested review round entry with findings and who each was routed to
record the sync attempt result (success/failure, external key/URL, timestamp) on the task's entry
record why the sync/PR was skipped (e.g. config still TBD, no commits/remote) rather than silently omitting it
